name: VOW
fix_description: getVOWVSCRate relies on usdRate values from VOW and VSC token contracts which were misconfigured, resulting in an extremely favorable exchange rate. tokensReceivedVOW uses this rate to mint VSC: attacker burns minimal VOW to mint massive VSC. Fix: add sanity bounds on the VOW/VSC rate (e.g., max mint ratio), or validate usdRate values are within expected ranges before computing the exchange.
notes: Disputed case: team was testing usdRate changes on mainnet and a MEV bot exploited the 15-30 second window of misconfigured rate. Not a code vulnerability per se — operational error (testing on mainnet). Contract functioned as designed.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC is a multi-step exploit involving a Uniswap V2 flash swap callback, interaction with a protocol-specific token manager, draining value through vUSD/VOW and VOW/USDT pools, and repayment logic. It requires understanding the target protocol’s flawed token/accounting behavior plus AMM reserve math, but the attack flow is still fairly linear and not deeply stateful or governance-level complex.
